description.blurb: Beli (formerly S/2004 S30 and Saturn LXI) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Beli is a Norse giant killed by Freyr with a staghorn. Beli is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1087.84 days, at 157.5° to the ecliptic.
